counters.name: template_sections_present_count
counters.command: py -c "import re; text=open('docs/adr/0003-single-spatial-primary-key.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); required=['Context','Decision','Alternatives Considered','Consequences','Positive','Negative','Risks']; names=[h[1].strip() for h in re.findall(r'^(#{2,3})\s+(.*)$', text, re.MULTILINE)]; print(sum(1 for r in required if r in names))"

counters.name: failure_mode_1_citation_count
counters.sample_size_note: denominator = total lines scanned in the ADR file (198), per brief.md's 'sample source' = 'full text of docs/adr/0003-<slug>.md'; NOT a copy of value. -CaseSensitive added so the command reproduces 22 exactly (case-insensitive matching also catches the capitalized 'Failure mode #1' bullet under ### Positive, yielding 23, one more than the recorded value).

counters.name: readme_unblock_reference_count
counters.sample_size_note: denominator = count of files scanned across both READMEs (2: sim/README.md, pipeline/geo/README.md), per brief.md's 'sample source' column; coincides numerically with value (one reference per file) but is derived independently, not copied from it.

counters.name: adr_index_rows_count
counters.sample_size_note: denominator = count of numbered NNNN-*.md files actually present under docs/adr/ on disk (3: 0001, 0002, 0003), per brief.md's 'denominator' column for this counter; the same Get-ChildItem invocation used for value is also the direct measurement of this denominator (unlike the other two counters above, brief.md defines this counter's value AND its denominator as the same disk-file count, so value == sample_size here is a second legitimate coincidence, not a placeholder copy).
